chapter: Second reel: instrument, style and wrap-up
title: The uncle's last job at the Budweiser and his age
summary: Russell and Nelson confirm that the Budweiser was the uncle's last job and that he was about twenty years older than Nelson.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: That was his last job then, your uncle's last job was up at the Budweiser.

Johnny St. Cyr told me something about it that time too. He wasn't there of course because he was playing banjo and guitar too those days. Some other people have told me about it. How much older was your uncle than you about? Could you guess about how much older he'd be, 10 or 20 years or something? About 20 years old.
